decisions.reason: Turnaround management sits close to the core offer, has its own page, and supports the integrated, data-driven direction, so it likely meets aspirations while the growing firm has slack to carry it.

Billing software is furthest from the core competence and the 2024 pruning of apron modules shows willingness to cut, but without clear evidence of a shortfall and with slack available, the firm keeps it another year.
Equipment monitoring uses the installed base and strengthens lifecycle services, so it fits the firm's aspirations at low resource cost.
The controller safety alert service builds on tower and surveillance expertise and serves safety goals central to customers, so absent a visible shortfall it is retained.
